explanation: This slide showcases different models used to visualize DNA. It lists the Ribbon Model (representing the twisting sugar-phosphate backbone), the Straight Ladder Model (unwound ladder visualization), the Space-filling Model (showing three-dimensional electron cloud spacing of atoms), the Stick Model, and the Sequence Model (which represents DNA as a simple text string of bases, such as TACTTCAAAATCATGAAGTTTTAG). The slide also highlights the 5' and 3' orientation and carbon numbering (1', 2', 3', 4', 5') on the sugar ring.

questions.q: Which DNA model type represents the DNA structure simply as a text string of letters (e.g., TACTTCA...)?
questions.exp: Option C is correct because the slide displays a text sequence (TACTTCAAAATCATGAAGTTTTAG) and labels it as the 'Sequence Model'. The other models show physical or graphical structures.
